scenario_en: A background evidence extractor exits0 after reporting that its required input could not be read.
scenario_zh: 后台证据提取器读不到必需输入，报告阻塞后仍退出0。

name_zh: 整体与分片评估门槛
summary_en: Evaluate important task slices beside aggregate metrics using gates declared before inspecting the result.
summary_zh: 按看结果前声明的门槛，同时检查整体及重要任务分片。
scenario_en: A bilingual assistant passes95 of100 examples but fails all five Chinese examples.
scenario_zh: 双语助手100例通过95例，却失败全部5例中文。

name_zh: 可复用的来源风格档案
summary_en: Extract a compact style profile from real writing and reuse it across related outputs.
summary_zh: 从真实文字提取短风格档案，跨相关输出复用。
scenario_en: Draft release notes and a newsletter in the same author’s voice from five supplied samples.
scenario_zh: 用提供的五篇样稿，以同一作者风格写发布说明和通讯。

name_zh: 结构化状态与渲染证据结合
summary_en: Combine structured application state with rendered evidence when neither alone answers the task.
summary_zh: 单一证据不足时，结合结构化应用状态与渲染证据。
scenario_en: Verify that a generated scene places a prop in contact with the intended surface.
scenario_zh: 验证生成场景里道具与指定表面接触。

name_zh: 技术事实与产品约束分离
summary_en: Keep discovered implementation behavior separate from intended business constraints and explicit assumptions.
summary_zh: 将发现的实现行为与业务期望、显式假设分开。
scenario_en: A developer asks to add export functionality, and code happens to cap queries at 100 rows.
scenario_zh: 开发者要求导出，现有查询恰好 LIMIT 100。

name_zh: 首个可验证纵向切片
summary_en: Build one small end-to-end user path from the existing specification before expanding all layers.
summary_zh: 先按已有规范完成一条小而完整的用户路径，再扩展各层。
scenario_en: Implement an MVP that accepts a request, stores it and shows its status.
scenario_zh: 实现一个接受请求、保存并显示状态的 MVP。

name_zh: 校验拟执行的修改内容
summary_en: Validate the content an operation proposes to write before authorizing that operation.
summary_zh: 操作获准前，校验它拟写入的内容。
scenario_en: A Write request replaces an existing10-line note with900 lines under a local800-line policy.
scenario_zh: Write 请求将已有10行笔记替换为900行，本地政策上限800行。

name_en: Preserve Literal Examples Across Invocation Templates
name_zh: 跨调用模板保留示例字面值
summary_en: Keep example-language syntax separate from the host's invocation-template syntax.
summary_zh: 把示例语言语法与宿主调用模板语法分开。
scenario_en: A review skill demonstrates PostgreSQL parameter binding, while its host expands positional argument markers in the skill body.
scenario_zh: 评审技能演示 PostgreSQL 参数绑定，而宿主会展开技能正文中的位置参数标记。

name_zh: 本地化时保留可执行标识符
summary_en: Separate translated explanation from literal symbols used by an instruction loader or reference resolver.
summary_zh: 将可翻译的说明与加载器、引用解析器实际使用的字面标识符分开。
scenario_en: Localize a skill whose known identity is name: release-check, invocation is $release-check, and reference is references/checklist.md. The task authorizes translation, not renaming.
scenario_zh: 将技能翻译成中文：已知身份为 name: release-check，调用为 $release-check，引用为 references/checklist.md；任务只授权翻译，没有授权改名。

name_zh: 隔离可选能力加载故障
summary_en: Load optional infrastructure behind the capability boundary and expose its failure honestly.
summary_zh: 在能力边界后加载可选基础设施，并诚实展示加载失败。
scenario_en: A partially installed toolkit has its source-reader but lacks the changed-file tracker module.
scenario_zh: 工具包部分安装，源码读取器存在，但改动文件追踪模块缺失。

name_zh: 版本绑定的文档检索
summary_en: Resolve the exact library and requested version before using retrieved API guidance.
summary_zh: 确认库身份与所需版本后，再使用检索到的 API 指南。
scenario_en: Configure middleware in an application whose installed framework version differs from a remembered example.
scenario_zh: 应用安装版本与记忆中的中间件例子不同。

name_zh: 保留已接受义务的修订记录
summary_en: Carry accepted requirements into later revisions while preserving the amendment history.
summary_zh: 把已接受的要求带入后续版本，同时保留修订历史。
scenario_en: Design review adds an accessibility obligation to a plan that engineering will revise.
scenario_zh: 设计审查新增了无障碍要求，之后工程审查还要修改计划。

name_en: Separate behavior success from intervention benefit
name_zh: 区分行为通过与干预收益
summary_en: Report whether the requested behavior works separately from whether an added instruction improves it.
summary_zh: 分别报告目标行为是否可用，以及新增指令是否改善该行为。
scenario_en: Both the baseline and a new prompt overlay solve every fixture correctly.
scenario_zh: 基线与新提示 overlay 都正确完成了每个 fixture。

name_zh: 按宿主能力分层的指令摘要
summary_en: Give hosts that can read instruction files but cannot run the full skill suite a small, versioned behavioral core.
summary_zh: 为能读取指令文件、却无法运行完整 skill 套件的宿主提供小型、带版本的行为准则。
scenario_en: A team uses an agent host without slash-skill installation; copying every workflow into project context is expensive and can imply tools the host lacks.
scenario_zh: 团队使用不支持斜杠 skill 安装的代理宿主；把所有工作流塞入项目上下文既昂贵，也可能暗示宿主拥有实际缺少的工具。

name_zh: 按可比覆盖范围报告趋势
summary_en: Compare result trends only when the covered checks and measurement conditions match.
summary_zh: 只有覆盖检查和测量条件一致时，才比较结果趋势。
scenario_en: A dashboard score rises after the failing linter is omitted from the next run.
scenario_zh: 下一轮检查省略了失败的 linter，仪表盘总分随之升高。

name_en: Budget context by when it loads
name_zh: 按加载时机分账计算上下文
summary_en: Measure always-loaded metadata separately from the full content eagerly loaded for one invocation.
summary_zh: 把常驻元数据与单次调用必须加载的全文分别计算。
scenario_en: A skill pack shortens each entry file but forces the same long reference to be read at startup.
scenario_zh: Skill 包缩短了入口文件，却要求启动时读取同一份长参考资料。

name_en: Keep claims within the observed channel
name_zh: 让结论保持在已观测的证据通道内
summary_en: Preserve a finding's evidence limits in every summary and proposed regression assertion.
summary_zh: 在所有摘要与拟议回归断言中保留发现的证据边界。
scenario_en: A browser probe captures an error-shaped console message, but no uncaught-exception evidence.
scenario_zh: 浏览器探测记录了一个形似错误的控制台消息，但没有未捕获异常的证据。

name_en: Revoke the prior grant when narrowing access
name_zh: 缩小权限时撤销旧授权
summary_en: Narrow an existing agent grant without leaving its old broader credential usable.
summary_zh: 缩小现有 Agent 权限时，避免旧的宽权限凭据继续可用。
scenario_en: A browser agent should keep read access after its write permission is withdrawn.
scenario_zh: 浏览器 Agent 撤销写权限后，还需保留读取能力。

name_zh: 独立的完成证据见证
summary_en: Separate externally witnessed behavior from completion claims made by the code being evaluated.
summary_zh: 把外部见证的行为与被评估代码自己报告的完成状态分开。
scenario_en: An untrusted application prints a passing test summary while the evaluator checks an authorization repair.
scenario_zh: 评估授权修复时，不可信应用打印了一段全部测试通过的摘要。

name_zh: 审查重叠异步操作的完成顺序
summary_en: Test a shared-state invariant across competing asynchronous operations, rather than reviewing each operation alone.
summary_zh: 围绕共享状态不变量检查相互竞争的异步操作，而不只分别审核每个操作。
scenario_en: A delayed refresh and a save both update the same editor document.
scenario_zh: 延迟刷新与保存操作都会更新同一编辑器文档。

name_zh: 按所有权令牌执行收尾清理
summary_en: Release only temporary state created and still owned by the current operation.
summary_zh: 只释放由当前操作创建且仍由它持有的临时状态。
scenario_en: An investigation acquires a scoped lock, then another session replaces it at the same path.
scenario_zh: 调查取得一个范围锁后，另一会话在同一路径替换了该锁。

name_zh: 以目标用户旅程为基准的同类比较
summary_en: Compare developer journeys only after naming the persona and the path from documented start to first understood useful result; keep estimated and unknown times explicit.
summary_zh: 先说明面向哪类开发者，以及从文档起点到首次理解有用结果的完整路径，再比较体验；估算值和未知值都要明确标出。
scenario_en: A team claims its SDK onboarding is faster than peers, although its quickstart paths require different setup and stop at different results.
scenario_zh: 团队声称 SDK 入门比同类产品快，但各家的快速开始流程要求不同，结束位置也不相同。

name_zh: 预先确定试验次数与判定规则
summary_en: Fix a stochastic evaluation panel before seeing outcomes and retain every planned attempt.
summary_zh: 看到结果之前固定随机评估的试验面板，并保留所有计划内尝试。
scenario_en: A prompt evaluation has two passing trials and one failed safety contract.
scenario_zh: 提示词评估中两轮通过，一轮违反安全契约。

name_en: Codify a proven run with replay
name_zh: 通过重放固化已成功流程
summary_en: Turn an accepted successful interaction trace into a deterministic reusable procedure, then verify replay against its accepted evidence.
summary_zh: 把已接受的成功交互轨迹变成确定的可复用流程，并用当时的证据验证重放。
scenario_en: A browser extraction worked once and should become a reusable read-only tool.
scenario_zh: 一次浏览器提取已成功，现在希望固化为可复用只读工具。

name_en: Verify a save against the selected target
name_zh: 在所选目标中回读验证保存
summary_en: Verify persisted context in the intended account, source and storage target before reporting a successful save.
summary_zh: 报告保存成功前，在预期账号、来源与存储目标中验证持久化上下文。
scenario_en: A context tool returns success after writing a design decision to a different selected corpus.
scenario_zh: 上下文工具写入另一份已选择语料后，仍返回成功。
